US Factory Workers Revolt Over Trump Tariffs Ahead of Midterms

Republican factory workers, who previously supported President Trump's "re-shoring" policies, are expressing backlash and planning to vote Democrat in the upcoming midterms due to job losses and factory closures attributed to Trump's tariffs. One voter, who stated "So much for bringing jobs back," plans to vote straight Democrat. This sentiment indicates a potential shift in voter allegiance among a key demographic.
